cues: Take a weak electrolyte A B at concentration C.
At equilibrium, a fraction alpha, the degree of ionisation, has split into ions.
So the ions are C alpha each, and the molecules left are C times one minus alpha.
text: Ostwald's dilution law. Take a weak electrolyte A B at concentration C. At equilibrium, a fraction alpha, the degree of ionisation, has split into ions. So the ions are C alpha each, and the molecules left are C times one minus alpha.
